source.title: Hinterlands Mission IV: Dragon Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'wath. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Laninar there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Laninar in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the archway in Agol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
